en: Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor root-cause and is not rootless, there arises a state that is unwholesome, both a root-cause and accompanied by a root-cause, by way of the root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor root-cause and is not rootless, there arises a state that is indeterminate, both a root-cause and accompanied by a root-cause, by way of the root-condition. ... [Two.]
(Not wholesome: two; not indeterminate: two. First, one by way of counting; second, one by way of counting; third, one by way of counting; in all cases there are nine questions.
With root: nine ... pe ... with resultant: three ... pe ... with non-disappearance: nine.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor rootless and is not a root, an unwholesome state that is both accompanied by a root and is not a root arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. With root: nine ... pe ... with resultant: three ... pe ... with non-disappearance: nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-root and dissociated from roots, there arises an unwholesome state that is both a root and associated with roots, by way of the root condition.
(Abbreviated. In the case of roots, nine; ... pe ... in the case of resultants, three; ... pe ...
in the case of non-disappearance, nine. (This is the same as the "root-with-root" [formula].)

Dependent on a state that is unwholesome, dissociated from roots, and not itself a root, there arises an unwholesome state associated with roots but not itself a root, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Nine [answers] for root;
... three for resultant; ... nine for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome, nor a root, nor accompanied by a root, there arises a neutral state that is not a root but is accompanied by a root, by way of the root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three for the root [condition] … pe … three for the non-disappearance [condition].
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome, nor a root, nor rootless, there arises an unwholesome state that is not a root and is rootless, by way of the root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome, nor a root, nor rootless, there arises a neutral state that is not a root and is rootless, by way of the root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is indeterminate, not a cause, and without a cause, there arises an indeterminate state that is not a cause and without a cause, by way of the root condition. (By calculation, there are three questions. Under the root condition, there are six;

under the predominance condition, there are six ... [and so on] ... under the mutuality condition, there are three ... [and so on] ... under the resultant condition, there are three ... [and so on] ... under the non-disappearance condition, there are six.
